source: Park, R. and Dai Ruitong (1988). A comparison of the behaviour of reinforced concrete beam-column joints designed for ductility and limited ductility. Bulletin NZNSEE 21(4), 255-278. Fig. 16(a) (p. 267), Table 4 (p. 264), section 4.1 (pp. 267-268), Table 5.1 of PEER 2003/10 (p. 51) for the tabulated observations.

digitization.method: manual reading of the peak of each load run from a 300 dpi render of the scanned Fig. 16(a); axes -120..120 mm and -90..90 kN; run numbers printed on the figure identify the cycles
digitization.notes: the scan overlaps the run labels with the loops near the peaks; values at mu = 7 second cycle (runs 25, 26) are the least certain; the loops themselves are not digitized point by point

yield_displacement_mm.basis: inferred: mu = 2 falls at about 30 mm and mu = 7 at about 105 mm on Fig. 16(a); the paper text does not print Delta_y for Unit 1 (Ref. 8 report); the OpenSees example's peakpts (30, 45, 60, 75, 90, 105) imply the same 15 mm

load_controlled_first_cycle.basis: 0.75 x V2 in both directions (section 3.2, Fig. 15); run 1 peak read at about +55 kN, +12 mm

maximum_load_kN.source: section 4.1 text and PEER Table 5.1; Vmax / V2 = 1.11

load_at_zero_displacement_kN.basis: the reloading branches at mu >= 4 cross delta = 0 at about +-25 to 30 kN on Fig. 16(a)

residual_displacement_at_zero_load_mm.basis: unloading branches from +90 and +105 mm reach V = 0 at about 35 and 42 mm

pinching_indicators.qualitative: pinching not significant (PEER Table 5.1); the paper: strength, stiffness and energy dissipation maintained well

strength_retention.final_cycle_over_theoretical: about 100 % (PEER Table 5.1); the paper: strength degradation of Unit 1 at the end of testing was small

damage_observations.joint_hoop_strain: did not exceed about twice the yield strain (1.4e-3) (section 4.2, Fig. 17a)
damage_observations.beam_bar_strains: yielding penetrated into the joint core; bar stress below yield in the middle quarter of the joint; top bars yielded in tension only; bottom bars yielded in tension and compression in the beam but only in tension inside the joint (section 4.2 text, Fig. 20a)
damage_observations.failure_mode: beam plastic hinges at the column faces (negative moment) and near the gravity load point (positive moment); columns elastic; joint diagonal tension cracking well controlled

protocol.sequence: load-controlled cycle to +-0.75 V2, then displacement-controlled cycles, two at each of mu = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
protocol.yield_definition: Delta_y = (4/3) x 0.5 x (Delta_y1 + Delta_y2), the displacements at +-0.75 V2
